conceptZh: 玩具機器人小心翼翼地端著一桶黑色顏料走路，在完全平坦的地上莫名絆了一下，整桶顏料倒扣在自己身上，全身變得黑漆漆只剩兩顆圓眼睛；旁邊的小鴨只被噴到一個黑點，低頭看了看，又抬頭看看他。
object: a small toy robot, a bucket of black paint and a tiny rubber duck
morph: the glyph 黑 stands still as a solid sculpture while the paint gag plays out at its base
creativeAngle: 顏色字最怕抽象，直接讓角色整個變成那個顏色最好懂；笑點用「在完全平坦的地上絆倒」的無理由，加上小鴨只中一滴的對比收尾。黑十二畫、下面四點最容易連成一條線，字體靜止並特別要求四點分開。語音詞「黑色」，黑ㄏㄟ、色ㄙㄜˋ都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale cream background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 黑 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep ink black, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the upper section sits above four separate dots along the bottom, and those four dots must stay clearly apart from each other and never merge into a bar. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. At its base a small boxy toy robot carries a bucket of black paint with enormous care, taking tiny deliberate steps across completely flat, completely empty floor, tongue out in concentration. A tiny yellow rubber duck sits watching to his right. At 1.8 seconds he trips over absolutely nothing. The bucket flips up and lands neatly upside-down over him, and when it lifts away at 2.4 seconds he is glossy black from head to toe, with only two round white eyes blinking out. He looks down at himself. Beat. At 3.2 seconds the duck, which has received exactly one small black spot on its back, cranes round to inspect the spot, then looks up at the robot, then back at the spot. The robot gives the duck a slow, dignified nod, and the two of them walk out of frame together to the right by 4.6 seconds. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 黑 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「黑、黑、黑色」, using the reading ㄏㄟ for 黑 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 黑 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 黑色 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 黑: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 太空人玩偶漂浮時，黑色顆粒從四邊偷偷溜進來，最後排成「黑」。
object: bouncy astronaut toy and drifting ink dots
morph: black dots arrive and become the four dots below 里
creativeAngle: 黑點從邊緣探頭、躲開主角、最後歸位。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a pale-banana-yellow stage; the glyph is a solid charcoal black 黑 with four round dots on the bottom row. A bouncy astronaut figure in a fishbowl helmet floats slightly above the floor at left. The Traditional Chinese glyph 黑 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): four fluffy charcoal dots peek in from the edges and dodge the astronaut's reaching glove; the first 黑 is spoken as the first dot peeks in. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the astronaut drifts upward in a slow somersault; the dots dart in and settle under the upper box one by one, the upper strokes sliding in at the same time; the second 黑 is spoken as the last dot lands. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): a toy blackboard on little wheels rolls in with chalk dust puffing; 黑板 is spoken as it stops. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 黑 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the astronaut floats down, holds a piece of chalk and does a slow wave while the glyph holds. Audio: one warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in Taiwan-standard Mandarin, reading exactly these syllables with clear tones and no erhua: 「黑、黑、黑板」 (ㄏㄟ、ㄏㄟ、ㄏㄟ ㄅㄢˇ). Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.5s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only soft pops and chalk taps, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.

conceptZh: 毛茸茸的大怪獸想去抱那桶黑墨水，轉身時先被橡膠恐龍的大腳絆倒，一頭栽進墨水桶，全身變成黑色；接著在恐龍的橡膠肚皮上彈起，在天花板、牆壁、地板、恐龍頭上彈來彈去，每撞一下就蓋出「黑」的一筆墨印，最後一彈甩下四滴墨變成底下四點，大怪獸坐在恐龍頭上得意拍著自己黑黑的肚子。
object: a huge round fuzzy one-horned monster, a tub of glossy black ink, and a rubber dinosaur whose belly works as a trampoline
morph: the ink-soaked monster ricochets around the frame and every impact stamps one black stroke of 黑 into the center; the final squash shakes four ink drops off its fur that land as the four bottom dots
creativeAngle: 前兩版都是慢慢的、靜態的（機器人打翻顏料、顆粒溜進來），這版改成真正的彈跳連鎖：怪獸本身就是沾滿墨水的印章，每次撞擊「喀」一聲蓋出一筆，筆畫由撞擊產生而不是自己滑進來。「黑」的字義直接變成笑點：綠色的毛怪栽進墨桶整隻變黑，念「黑色」時牠正拍著自己黑黑的肚子。恐龍只當彈簧床和寶座，小短手搆不到頭上的怪獸，讓最後三秒的定格仍有小動作。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy comedy in one continuous locked-off frontal shot on a clean solid soft mint-green background with a flat floor and nothing else behind. The single piece of on-screen text is one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 黑, built up stroke by stroke in solid glossy ink black and ending centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. Use standard textbook proportions: the upper block is a box divided by a central vertical stroke, standing on a horizontal stroke with a longer base horizontal beneath it, and below that sit four separate round dots in a row that never touch or merge into a bar.

Cast: the lead is a huge round fuzzy lime-green cartoon monster with one stubby horn and a goofy wide grin, far clumsier than scary. The buddy is an orange rubber dinosaur with enormous flat feet and comically tiny arms that cannot reach anything. Prop: a wide tub of glossy black ink at the right edge.

0.0 to 1.5 seconds: the monster stands at the left, spots the ink tub, points at it with both fuzzy paws, grins, and winds up with a big bottom-wiggle. It charges right across the frame, trips over the dinosaur's enormous foot in the middle, and belly-flops headfirst into the tub with a thick glossy SPLOOSH. The first spoken 黑 lands as the monster plunges in.

1.5 to 3.5 seconds: the monster pops out dripping and completely black from horn to toes, only two round white eyes blinking. It slips on the spilled ink, flies backward onto the dinosaur's rubber belly, and springs off it like a trampoline. Fast ricochet chain with cartoon squash-and-stretch: it hits the ceiling with a CLACK and the upper box of 黑 stamps into the center as a black ink print; hits the left wall with a CLACK and the central vertical plus the short horizontal stamp in; hits the floor with a CLACK and the long base horizontal stamps in; bonks the dinosaur on the head with a soft rubbery BOINK so the dinosaur's whole body wobbles like jelly while its tiny arms flail uselessly. Every stamp is a sharp clean black stroke in exactly the right place.

3.5 to 5.0 seconds: the last bounce drops the monster bottom-first onto the dinosaur's head at the lower right, beside the glyph and never covering it. The landing squash shakes four fat black ink drops off its fur, and they fly in an arc and land one by one along the bottom row as the four separate dots, left to right, each with a small clack. The second spoken 黑 lands exactly as the fourth dot settles and the character is complete. The dinosaur's tiny arms reach up to shove the monster off and cannot get anywhere near it.

5.0 to 8.0 seconds: the finished 黑 holds perfectly still, centered and unobstructed. The monster, now entirely black, looks down at itself, pats its own black belly proudly with both paws, holds up one black fuzzy paw to show it off, and gives a dizzy happy grin; the dinosaur underneath keeps wobbling and swatting at the air with its tiny arms. The word 黑色 is spoken while the monster shows off its black paw, so the color is on screen at the moment it is named. No strokes move, get touched or get covered during the hold.

Style: Pixar-like chunky glossy toy materials, fluffy fur on the monster, matte rubber on the dinosaur, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no white blowouts and no dark or moody grading. Cartoon bonks only, nobody hurt, nothing startling.

Audio: one warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in Taiwan-standard Mandarin, reading exactly these syllables with clear tones and no erhua: 「黑、黑、黑色」 (ㄏㄟ、ㄏㄟ、ㄏㄟ ㄙㄜˋ). Timing: first 黑 at about 0.9 seconds, second 黑 at about 4.6 seconds, 黑色 at about 5.8 seconds; then stop, with no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only soft clacks, boings and one sploosh, kept quieter than the voice, no music. The vocabulary word is audio only: the single glyph 黑 is the only text anywhere in the frame, with no subtitles, letters, numbers, watermark, extra props, particles, clutter or flashing effects.
